turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! How is your Thursday going? Are you getting ready for another night shift at the ER?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yeah, just waking up and trying to get my brain functioning. The Phoenix heat is already pretty intense today, so I poured myself a big glass of that iced, slowly steeped coffee I keep in the fridge. I definitely needed the caffeine boost.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like the perfect way to wake up on a hot afternoon! How are you planning to get to the hospital for your shift tonight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I was feeling a bit too tired to deal with traffic, so I actually ended up hailing a ride on my app today instead of driving myself. It's nice to just sit in the back and relax before a long night.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a much more peaceful start to your evening. Did you manage to pack a good dinner to take with you for your break?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I boxed up the extra portions of the chicken stir-fry Tom and I made last night, so I've got that ready to heat up in the breakroom later.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Yum, homemade meals are the best for a busy shift. Speaking of cooking, have you had any time for sourdough baking recently?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not this week, unfortunately. My starter is happily chilling in the fridge, but between my shifts and catching up on sleep, I haven't had the energy to do a full bake. I might try to get a loaf going this weekend though.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's completely fair, sleep definitely comes first. Have you been able to fit in any salsa dancing lately, or has work been too demanding?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Tom and I actually went out dancing last Tuesday! It was a blast and a great way to decompress. The ER has been pretty chaotic with the summer heat starting to pick up, so I really needed the break.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'm glad you and Tom got to go out and enjoy some dancing! The ER must keep you incredibly busy, especially this time of year. I hope tonight is a relatively smooth shift for you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! My driver is pulling up to the hospital entrance now, so I'm going to head inside and get clocked in. Talk to you tomorrow!
